Project Information

JSA ID: SCAFF-__________ DATE: ______________ TIME: ______________

PROJECT: ______________ LOCATION: ______________ HEIGHT: ______________ ft

SCAFFOLD TYPE: ______________ COMPETENT PERSON: ______________ CREW SIZE: ______________

Job Steps & Hazard Analysis

JOB STEPHAZARDS IDENTIFIEDPOTENTIAL CONSEQUENCERISK RATING (L x S)CONTROL MEASURES
1. Site Prep & Inspection-Unstable ground
-Damaged components		-Collapse
-Crush injuries		15 (HIGH)-Inspect all components
-Verify ground capacity
-Level and compact area
-Remove defective parts
2. Base Setup & Leveling-Improper base plates
-Unlevel sills		-Settlement
-Tip over		12 (HIGH)-Use base plates with screw jacks
-Install mud sills
-Level each screw jack
-Check plumb
3. Frame Assembly-Unstable connections
-Missing pins		-Fall from height
-Falling objects		20 (VERY HIGH)-Full body harness with lanyard
-Tie off to anchor point
-Install all pins and braces
-3-point contact
4. Platform Installation-Gaps in deck
-Unsecured planks
-Missing guardrails		-Fall through
-Trip hazards		12 (HIGH)-Fully plank working levels
-Ensure planks overlap 12"
-Install guardrails top/mid/toe
-Remove damaged planks
5. Access & Ties-Improper ladder angle
-Insufficient ties		-Fall during access
-Collapse		15 (HIGH)-Secure ladder at top and bottom
-Extend ladder 3' above platform
-Install ties every 26' vertically
-Check all couplers tight

REQUIRED PPE: ☐ Hard Hat ☐ Safety Glasses ☐ High-Vis Vest ☐ Steel-Toe Boots ☐ Full Body Harness ☐ Gloves
